registered_before: the final live run (pulse-live-final-<MMDD>); its rehearsal (pulse-final-rehearsal-1119, 6 trials) only checked that every step runs and set the duration (138 s per trial)
supersedes: pulse-live-v7-v1 (run stopped before any attack on the owner's order for improvement-round-v1)
owner_decisions: 19/11: try every direction first (improvement-round-v1), then one final live run of reasonable length, not limited to 26 h
seen_before_registration: all results of pulse-live-v5-1110, pulse-live-v6-1117, improvement-round-v1 and the rehearsal (6 trials: every step ran; event-generator outcomes executed/error/skipped as expected)

system.model: lidds-ml-v5-t3 (select1f, n 4, Witten-Bell, top 3, trim 0.005, alpha prime 0.0003, 5-fold cross-fit, one window fires)
system.probe: /home/dat/pulse-tokens-final-f8ccbb2 (D1 overflow alert, D2 loader window end; token proof valid on the three workers)
system.bridge: durable push queue (D3), alert label stream (native/session from the lineage tag)
system.datasets: no rerun needed: lidds-ml-v5-t3 is measured on LID-DS 2021 official (1,236/1,271, 15/7,938), LID-DS 2019 holdout (817/841 with the 1 s tolerance) and CB-DS (891/891, 3); no adopted change of improvement-round-v1 touches dataset scoring

campaign.base: 21 workloads x 5 scenarios x rates 1, 3, 6, 12, 24 per s (525)
campaign.on_off: period 10 s at 12 per s (105, D12)
campaign.steps: control, operator command (v6 set), harmless binary, living off the land, event-generator action (D18, amendment 3/4, 14 actions), seeded random order
campaign.timing: rehearsal 138 s per trial: campaign about 36.2 h after a 1.5 h selection span, then about 6 h of normal without campaign
campaign.k8s_events: recorded for the whole run (D10 operational labels)

hypotheses.H0: primary set (6, 12, 24 per s): recall >= 95 %, idle control positives <= 5 %, precision (1:1) >= 95 %, p95 kernel -> end of alarm window <= 3 s
hypotheses.H7: slow rates 0.5 and 0.1 per s: recall >= 95 % each

reported: event-generator per action and pooled (model alone)
living off the land, operator commands, harmless binaries (model alone)
burden on the normal tail after the campaign (episodes per replica-hour, clustered bootstrap), episodes labelled by Kubernetes events (D10) and by stream
gram-map overflow alerts (expected 0) and insert failures
bridge delivery, durable queue use, kernel -> Alertmanager latency
side by side with pulse-live-v6-1117 (lidds-ml-v5 on the shared base design)
afterwards, as the rule track: an intent-catalogue rule on the living-off-the-land and event-generator steps, with and without
rules: run the full cycle; no heavy job on any node during the run; infrastructure faults are excluded spans, not a reason to stop
